pr_title: scbuild: fix unhandled case during DROP SCHEMA
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/135141
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/133913
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/134752
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/134280
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/133510

Release note (bug fix): Fixed an unhandled error that would occur if DROP SCHEMA was executed on the `public` schema of the `system` database, or on an internal schema like `pg_catalog` or `information_schema`.

or any of the internal schema like `pg_catalog`
